leadStory: After a fortnight of arithmetic the Barcola pursuit found daylight: PSG spent the weekend signing the forwards meant to cover his exit, Ferran Torres in from Barcelona on the No. 9 and a €55m package verbally agreed with Ajax for Mika Godts, and are now reported willing to lower a valuation that had held near £145m. The France winger has wanted Anfield all summer; for the first time the path is open, not just the desire, though Liverpool must still climb toward PSG's number. The fallback board thinned the same day, Brighton's Yankuba Minteh out up to three months injured, with Everton's Iliman Ndiaye a newer, pricier name. Como close the pre-season at Anfield today, Araujo set for his bow, before Newcastle away opens the league on August 23.
subject: A transfer negotiation gaining momentum as PSG buy Barcola's replacements, not a single photographable hero moment
